notes.title: Update: Eliminated Players Dont Reduce MAX Bet Size
notes.notes:
This update doesn't reduce the players maximum bet when CPU players are eliminated due to losing all their funds. Previously as CPU players were eliminated from play the maximum bet a player could make was reduced (seating more players increases the amount you can bet each hand). Now that has been modified and the maximum bet is calculated by the number of players seated at the start of the game and will remain consistent for the entire match.

Players should now be able to complete "First to $XX,000" games much quicker since their max bet size will not be reduced as CPU players are eliminated from these typically longer matches.  

HOW TO Unlock Animated Showdowns GIF:
If you get caught cheating you will be challenged to a showdown vs the CPU player. The default game only shows the win/lose result. Here's how to show animated showdowns instead. NOTE: Animated Showdowns contain animated cartoon violence and must be enabled each game boot.
GIF: https://gfycat.com/IllinformedBronzeConey

notes.title: Update: Minor Bug Fixes + Internet Hi-Scores
notes.notes: Minor update with stability enhancements. Some AMD systems were unstable depending on the computer config. This update should fix most of those issues. Bet amounts are now saved between reloads. Also now you have to start a game with 3 or 4 CPU players to save hi-scores to the web. Overall it shouldnt make too much of a difference since users play vs the dealer to win each hand but games feel a little more competitive when more players are seated and you must defeat them too. Good Luck!

notes.title: Update: RELOAD SAVES + Popup Tips + Blackjack Payout
notes.notes: The Latest CB21 update allows you to reload previous games. If you exit a game before finishing it will be saved so you can continue at a later time. All game modes except FREE Play allow you to reload games in progress. More Popup tips have been added and the chance of them appearing has been reduced. Blackjack payouts have been adjusted. Previous versions paid 3:2 for non-blackjack "21" hands. Now only 2 card Blackjack pays 3:2. Also the game gives the choice to preload CPU players. You still have the option to customize the table before starting play but seating CPU players is easier and quicker.

notes.title: BUG Fix - LINUX!! - CPU Blackjacks - "21" Fixes
notes.notes:
Latest version stomps a few bugs. #1 the CPU wasnt scoring their Blackjacks and always drew an extra card as if they only counted the hand as 11 and not 21 (Actually took me a minute to notice it since the next card was usually a 10 and the CPU would win with 21 anyway). Ended up being a bug that only took 2 characters to fix (thats how easy it is to introduce errors into code). A statement that should have said '&&' (AND) was mistakenly changed to ''||' (OR). Sheesh.... Now the CPU will recognize when it has Blackjack.

Next up. Hands of 21 with more than 2 cards were marked as 'Blackjack'. It made no difference in the scoring but now those hands are properly titled as '21'. Also soon I'll be adding a couple more 2+ CPU player achievements to encourage playing the game against CPU players. 

NOTE: To rank for the the Hi-Score boards you must play with at least 1 CPU opponent. Quick Tip: To collect Cheat Percent Faster play 2 or more seats (Your max bet per hand will be split between the seats). 

EDIT: CB21 Now Available for Ubuntu Linux 14.0.4 Compatible OS's
